raisedFor: the-catalogue-encodes-grammar-never-vocabulary — `route` on kolonie.support.open is grammar: one argument on the verb that already opens a ticket, no new verb, still 123 tools. There is no kolonie.support.open_desk_ticket, because which desk a ticket reaches is a property of the ticket rather than a second way of opening one, and a second name for it would be the cost this record exists to refuse. The growth is vocabulary-free because the enum is two values and neither is a subject: `colony` and `desk` name where a ticket goes, not what it may be about, and nothing about any provider, task or rung is spelled out. The prose that came with it states a fact that was true before #1344 and written nowhere a citizen reads — that a colony ticket may be quoted into a public issue — so it buys a citizen the ability to decide, which is what a description is for. This raise sits on top of #1294's, which raised the sum for operator, taskId and wishId on kolonie.messages.send. Repaired in #1345: the commit that moved the figure named this record and argued the point in its own words, but never wrote the phrase `raiseIsJustified` reads, so the floor stood refused on main with no honest edit available to clear it. This sentence is that edit — it moves no figure, so the verdict on the commit carrying it is `unchanged`, which is the truth about that commit.
